story_description: Provide debugging and testing capabilities for hook development, enabling developers to trace hook execution, inspect intermediate values, and identify issues during hook development without leaving the Blaze environment.
task_description: Create HookDebugService actor that integrates with Claude Code debug mode (CLAUDE_DEBUG=1), parses debug output for hook execution traces, and provides real-time monitoring of hook executions during development sessions.
atom_description: Implement HookDebugService actor providing three core capabilities: enableDebugMode() to configure CLAUDE_DEBUG=1 environment variable for subsequent CLI sessions, parseDebugOutput() to extract structured HookExecutionTrace records from debug log output, and startMonitoring() to provide real-time AsyncStream of hook execution events by watching debug logs during active sessions.
problem_statement: Hook development currently requires manual inspection of Claude Code debug logs to understand hook execution behavior. Developers must set CLAUDE_DEBUG=1 manually, locate the appropriate log files, and parse unstructured text output to trace hook execution. This workflow is error-prone and disconnects debugging from the visual builder context. Blaze needs a structured debug integration service that automates environment configuration, parses debug output into structured traces, and streams execution events in real-time for display in the hook builder UI.

assumptions: Claude Code debug mode outputs hook execution logs to stderr with predictable format
Debug log format includes hook name, event type, start/end timestamps, and exit status
Claude Code creates debug logs in project .claude directory or temp directory

constraints: Must not modify global environment variables that affect other processes
Must use DispatchSource or FileManager for file watching (no FSEvents directly)
Must not block main thread during log parsing or file watching
Must support cancellation of monitoring via Task cancellation
Must not leak file handles when monitoring is stopped
Must handle log rotation or truncation gracefully

functional_requirements: FR1: HookDebugService shall provide enableDebugMode() async throws that configures CLAUDE_DEBUG=1 environment for subsequent EngineManager.submit() calls
FR2: HookDebugService shall provide disableDebugMode() that removes CLAUDE_DEBUG configuration and restores default environment
FR3: HookDebugService shall expose debugModeEnabled: Bool published property reflecting current debug configuration state
FR4: HookDebugService shall provide parseDebugOutput(_ output: String) -> [HookExecutionTrace] that extracts structured traces from debug log text
FR5: parseDebugOutput shall identify hook executions by regex pattern matching lines containing hook: prefix and event type markers
FR6: HookExecutionTrace shall contain hookName (String), eventType (HookEvent), startedAt (Date), completedAt (Date?), durationMs (Double?), result (HookResult), stdout (String), stderr (String)
FR7: HookDebugService shall provide startMonitoring(projectPath: String) -> AsyncStream<HookExecutionTrace> for real-time hook execution streaming
FR8: startMonitoring shall watch debug log file using DispatchSource and emit parsed traces as new content is appended
FR9: HookDebugService shall provide stopMonitoring() that cancels active file watching and terminates the AsyncStream
FR10: HookDebugService shall expose isMonitoring: Bool published property indicating active monitoring state
FR11: HookDebugService shall accumulate partial log lines across file reads to handle buffered writes correctly
FR12: HookDebugService shall emit debugTraceReceived notification via NotificationCenter for cross-component communication
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Log parsing shall process 1000 lines per second without UI lag
NFR2: File watching latency shall be under 100ms from log write to trace emission
NFR3: Memory usage for monitoring shall not exceed 10MB for log buffer and parsed traces
NFR4: Service shall support continuous monitoring for sessions lasting over 8 hours
NFR5: Trace parsing shall not crash on malformed or corrupted log entries
NFR6: Debug mode toggle shall take effect within 1 second of user action

Step 4: Define DebugLogPattern struct containing compiled NSRegularExpression patterns for hook log parsing

Step 9: Add private logWatcher: DispatchSourceFileSystemObject? property for file watching

Step 11: Add private lineBuffer: String property for accumulating partial lines across reads

Step 15: Implement disableDebugMode() that sets debugModeEnabled = false and updates SettingsStore
Step 16: Implement getEnvironmentOverrides() -> [String: String] that returns CLAUDE_DEBUG=1 if enabled, empty otherwise
Step 17: Implement parseDebugOutput(_ output: String) -> [HookExecutionTrace] with line-by-line regex matching
Step 18: Create regex patterns for: hook start (hook: <name> event=<type> started), hook end (hook: <name> completed result=<result> duration=<ms>ms)
Step 19: Implement parseHookStartLine(_ line: String) -> (name: String, event: HookEvent)? helper method
Step 20: Implement parseHookEndLine(_ line: String) -> (name: String, result: HookResult, durationMs: Double)? helper method
Step 21: Implement correlateStartEnd(_ starts: [(String, HookEvent, Date)], _ ends: [(String, HookResult, Double, Date)]) -> [HookExecutionTrace] to match pairs
Step 22: Implement startMonitoring(projectPath: String) -> AsyncStream<HookExecutionTrace> method
Step 23: Determine debug log path as projectPath/.claude/debug.log or fallback to system temp directory
Step 24: Open file handle for reading and seek to end for tail-like behavior
Step 25: Create DispatchSource.makeFileSystemObjectSource with .write event mask
Step 26: In source event handler, read new data from file handle and append to lineBuffer
Step 27: Extract complete lines from lineBuffer, parse each, and yield traces via continuation
Step 28: Set monitoringContinuation and isMonitoring = true on stream creation
Step 29: Implement stopMonitoring() that cancels DispatchSource, closes file handle, and finishes continuation
Step 30: Implement onCancel handler for AsyncStream to call stopMonitoring() automatically on consumer cancellation

Step 32: Implement addToActiveTraces(_ trace: HookExecutionTrace) that prepends trace and trims to 100 items

edge_cases: Edge case 1: Debug log file does not exist when monitoring starts - create file and watch for writes
Edge case 2: Debug log file is deleted while monitoring - detect removal and restart watching or error
Edge case 3: Log file rotated (renamed/truncated) mid-session - detect size decrease and reset file handle position
Edge case 4: Partial hook execution (start without end) due to crash - emit trace with completedAt = nil after timeout
Edge case 5: Multiple hooks executing concurrently - correlate by hookName, track parallel executions correctly
Edge case 6: Very long stdout/stderr in trace - truncate display to 10KB with See Full Output expansion
Edge case 7: Non-UTF8 bytes in log output - replace invalid sequences with replacement character
Edge case 8: Monitoring started but no log activity for extended period - show Waiting for activity status
Edge case 9: User disables debug mode while monitoring active - continue monitoring existing log but warn no new debug output
Edge case 10: Project path contains special characters or spaces - properly escape for file path handling
failure_modes: FM1: File permission denied when opening debug log - display Permission denied error with chmod suggestion
FM2: Disk full when debug logging enabled - warn user that debug mode increases disk usage
FM3: Regex parsing fails on unexpected log format - log warning, skip line, continue parsing
FM4: DispatchSource fails to activate - fall back to polling-based file watching every 500ms
FM5: Memory exhaustion from large log file - implement streaming parser, never load entire file
FM6: File handle leaked on improper shutdown - implement deinit cleanup and explicit close
FM7: NotificationCenter observer not removed - use weak references and automatic cleanup
FM8: Concurrent access to lineBuffer - actor isolation prevents data races
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/Settings/Hooks/HookDebugService.swift and HookExecutionTrace.swift files. Remove debugModeEnabled key from SettingsStore. risks: Risk 1: Claude Code debug log format may change between versions, breaking regex parsing
Risk 2: File watching may miss rapid writes if buffering causes coalesced events
Risk 3: Large debug logs may cause memory issues if entire file is read into buffer
Risk 4: DispatchSource may not fire on all file systems (network drives, FUSE mounts)
Risk 5: Actor isolation may cause unexpected UI update delays when processing many traces
mitigations: Mitigation 1: Implement pattern versioning with fallback to raw log display if parsing fails
Mitigation 2: Use small polling interval as backup when DispatchSource events seem missing
Mitigation 3: Implement streaming line parser that processes file incrementally, never loading full content
Mitigation 4: Detect file system type and fall back to polling for non-native file systems
Mitigation 5: Batch trace updates and emit on main actor with coalescing to prevent UI flooding
risk_register.blast_radius: Limited to debug mode feature in hook builder. Failure does not affect hook execution itself or other settings functionality. Users can debug hooks manually via terminal if service fails.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If file watching proves unreliable, implement manual refresh button that calls parseDebugOutput on current log file content. Users can still use debug mode but must manually trigger log parsing. No persistent state affected.
